blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 101 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 27, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & MRNA lead 101 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 32 Canadian and 69 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 27, 2026) found 101 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 32 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 10 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +99% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 16 names.

In the U.S., 69 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 28 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +328% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 23 names.
